=== THE TASK ===
Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180
minutes; every tool result reports how much of both you have spent. Spend as
much or as little as the job needs, and decide for yourself when the scene
matches the description.

clauses.text: Type: Sparse isolated winter settlement in a broad snow-filled basin
Conditions: Deep ivory snowdrifts covering the basin
Character: Quiet, spacious, weathered, only lightly inhabited
Location: Along one side of a frozen lake or broad flooded plain
Form: Large tall slabs, each about ten stories
Arrangement: Loosely grouped around short access roads and open courtyards rather than packed into a continuous street wall
Facades: Repetitive grid facades in weathered beige concrete
rows of small rectangular windows and darker recessed balcony bands
Position: Scattered in front of and between towers
past buildings, bending around courtyards, continuing beside lake
Crossing: Long straight low bridge carrying road across frozen water
edging parts of lakeside road and open ground
Landforms: Rolling wind-sculpted snowbanks, shallow gullies
Exposures: Patches of dark road or water
a few small frozen pools or irregular black ice openings
Count and placement: Several isolated cottages or utility-like brick structures among snow-covered slopes and woods
Details: Chimney, rooftop antennas, rising smoke
Near settlement: Dense snow-laden birch and pine stands
Open mounds: Sparser leafless trees and twisted bushes
Surrounding hills: Thicker evergreen forests climbing wooded enclosing hills
Transition: Outer edges dissolve into uneven snowy ridges, forested mountains, and the frozen lake

Scene:
  Type: Sparse isolated winter settlement in a broad snow-filled basin
  Lighting: Warm hazy sunset; long blue-gray shadows
  Conditions: Deep ivory snowdrifts covering the basin; occasional falling snow
  Character: Quiet, spacious, weathered, only lightly inhabited
Residential layout:
  Location: Along one side of a frozen lake or broad flooded plain
  Main blocks:
    Count: Roughly three
    Form: Large tall slabs, each about ten stories
    Arrangement: Loosely grouped around short access roads and open courtyards rather than packed into a continuous street wall
    Facades: Repetitive grid facades in weathered beige concrete; rows of small rectangular windows and darker recessed balcony bands
  Smaller apartments:
    Count: About five
    Position: Scattered in front of and between towers
    Form: Boxy brick; generally four or five stories
    Roofs: Snow-covered hipped or flat; chimneys and antennas
    Windows: A few warmly lit
Transport and fencing:
  Road: Narrow cracked asphalt; past buildings, bending around courtyards, continuing beside lake
  Crossing: Long straight low bridge carrying road across frozen water; simple piers
  Fence: Segmented decorative concrete; edging parts of lakeside road and open ground
Central landscape:
  Development: Largely undeveloped
  Landforms: Rolling wind-sculpted snowbanks, shallow gullies
  Exposures: Patches of dark road or water
  Details: Scattered shrubs; a few small frozen pools or irregular black ice openings
Outlying structures:
  Count and placement: Several isolated cottages or utility-like brick structures among snow-covered slopes and woods
  Specific house:
    Fabric: Weathered two-story masonry
    Details: Chimney, rooftop antennas, rising smoke
Vegetation:
  Distribution: Organic
  Near settlement: Dense snow-laden birch and pine stands
  Open mounds: Sparser leafless trees and twisted bushes
  Surrounding hills: Thicker evergreen forests climbing wooded enclosing hills
Outer boundary:
  Transition: Outer edges dissolve into uneven snowy ridges, forested mountains, and the frozen lake
